ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge tomviz_pipeline_dev
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
Node-graph pipeline engine for tomographic data processing, usable
standalone or embedded in applications such as tomviz. Provides the
tomviz-pipeline command that tomviz uses to execute pipelines in
external Python environments.

Note: versions up to 3.0.0 of this package were built from the
tomviz repository (tomviz feedstock) and installed a module named
"tomviz"; starting with 3.1.0 the package is developed in its own
repository and installs the "tomviz_pipeline" module.

name: tomviz-pipeline
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "3.1.4"

package:
  name: tomviz-pipeline
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/t/tomviz_pipeline/tomviz_pipeline-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2947f620ca3ea5dcced3722efac3140dd9c8ade266ab1143679dd0ae87db3f95

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  python:
    entry_points:
      - tomviz-pipeline = tomviz_pipeline.cli:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools >=77
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy
    - h5py
    - click
    - tqdm

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - tomviz_pipeline
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - script:
      - tomviz-pipeline --help

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/openchemistry/tomviz-pipeline
  repository: https://github.com/openchemistry/tomviz-pipeline
  summary: Node-graph pipeline engine for tomographic data processing
  description: |
    Node-graph pipeline engine for tomographic data processing, usable
    standalone or embedded in applications such as tomviz. Provides the
    tomviz-pipeline command that tomviz uses to execute pipelines in
    external Python environments.

    Note: versions up to 3.0.0 of this package were built from the
    tomviz repository (tomviz feedstock) and installed a module named
    "tomviz"; starting with 3.1.0 the package is developed in its own
    repository and installs the "tomviz_pipeline" module.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - psavery
    - alesgenova
